# CLI help (generated)

Generated by `node scripts/quality/check-contract-sync.mjs --write`; the contract-sync stage of the quality gate fails when it drifts. Do not edit by hand.

## `test-capabilities`

```text
Usage: test-capabilities [options] [command]

Fail-closed testing capability framework

Options:
  -V, --version                              output the version number
  -h, --help                                 display help for command

Commands:
  doctor [options]                           Run zero-external-dependency package and environment diagnostics
  init [options]                             Generate a minimal fail-closed test-capabilities.yaml config
  demo [options]                             Run the built-in zero-external-dependency demo fixture
  test [options]                             Run capability-backed testing suite
  surf [options] <action>                    Advanced browser testing with surf-cli
  predict [options]                          Predict potential failures using ML
  quantum [options]                          Run quantum test simulation
  heal [options]                             Analyze and fix broken tests
  replacement-validation [options] <action>  Plan dependency replacement validation from an explicit dep-surgeon request
  visualize [options]                        Generate interactive test visualization
  report [options]                           Generate comprehensive test report
  help [command]                             display help for command
```

## `test-capabilities test`

```text
Usage: test-capabilities test [options]

Run capability-backed testing suite

Options:
  -t, --target <target>             CLI command/path target, or a URL when a
                                    real web consumer is enabled (currently:
                                    quantum or an enabled bombadil/surf agent)
  -c, --config <file>               Configuration file (default:
                                    "test-capabilities.yaml")
  -a, --autonomous                  Enable full autonomous mode
  --self-heal                       Enable self-healing tests
  --supersede-receipt <receipt_id>  Proceed past an in-doubt mutation receipt
                                    you have inspected; the new receipt records
                                    which one it supersedes
  --predict                         Enable failure prediction
  --quick                           Quick sanity check mode
  --fail-threshold <level>          Fail threshold (low|medium|high|critical)
  --upload-artifacts                Upload artifacts to cloud
  --report <dir>                    Report output directory
  --json                            Print the full machine-readable operation
                                    envelope
  -h, --help                        display help for command
```

## `test-capabilities surf`

```text
Usage: test-capabilities surf [options] <action>

Advanced browser testing with surf-cli

Arguments:
  action                       Action: explore | plan (implemented) | apply |
                               flow | assert | compare | replay

Options:
  -u, --url <url>              Target URL
  --depth <n>                  Explore same-origin links to bounded depth 1-3
                               with graded probe coverage
  --ready-selector <css>       surf explore: a visible CSS selector the
                               readiness gate waits for; a selector it cannot
                               reach is diagnosed against the page's frames
  --frame-hint <kind=value>    surf explore: 'urlPrefix=<prefix>' or
                               'selector=<css>' asserting which frame the
                               --ready-selector target lives in; the only way
                               to confirm a frame boundary
  --frame-probe                surf explore: with --ready-selector and no
                               --frame-hint, look for the selector inside each
                               top-level candidate frame (frame.switch,
                               wait.element, frame.main); one hit with every
                               candidate answering confirms the frame
  --a11y-snapshot [mode]       surf explore: attach the read-only accessibility
                               observation channel (one surf page.read
                               --structure --full-page --nodes in the owned
                               tab); 'optional' (default) records an
                               unavailable channel and continues, 'required'
                               fails the page
  --field <locator=value>      surf plan: a field to fill, as
                               '<label|selector|name>:<locator>=<value>';
                               repeatable (default: [])
  --submit-text <text>         surf plan: narrow the submit candidates by
                               visible button text
  --submit-selector <css>      surf plan: narrow the submit candidates by CSS
                               selector
  --out <file>                 surf plan: write the reviewable plan artifact
                               here (mode 0600)
  --plan <file>                surf apply: the plan artifact to carry out
  --submit                     surf apply: open the submit gate; needs
                               --confirm-plan and an allowlisted origin
  --confirm-plan <token>       surf apply: the approval token printed by surf
                               plan
  --until-url-prefix <prefix>  surf apply: post-condition, the URL starts with
                               this
  --until-text <text>          surf apply: post-condition, the page contains
                               this text
  --receipt-out <file>         surf apply: export this run's mutation receipts
                               as one JSON
  -c, --config <file>          surf plan/apply: config file holding
                               mutation.allowOrigins, receipts.dir and
                               surf.submit.* (default:
                               "test-capabilities.yaml")
  --record                     Reserved surf explore flag; currently fails
                               until implemented
  --validate                   Reserved surf explore flag; currently fails
                               until implemented
  --baseline <dir>             Reserved surf explore flag; currently fails
                               until implemented
  --ai-diff                    Reserved surf explore flag; currently fails
                               until implemented
  -f, --file <path>            Reserved surf flag; currently fails until
                               implemented
  --json                       Print the full machine-readable operation
                               envelope
  -h, --help                   display help for command
```

## `test-capabilities heal`

```text
Usage: test-capabilities heal [options]

Analyze and fix broken tests

Options:
  -d, --dir <path>                  Tests directory (default: "./tests")
  --dry-run                         Show what would be fixed
  --proposal-output <file>          Write a dry-run healing proposal artifact
                                    as JSON for review or replay-ledger
                                    follow-through
  --verification-output <file>      Write a dry-run healing verification
                                    artifact as JSON after checking proposals
                                    in memory
  --proposal-input <file>           Apply proposals from a previously emitted
                                    healing proposal artifact; requires
                                    --checkpoint-ref
  --checkpoint-ref <ref>            External checkpoint identity required
                                    before applying healing proposals
  --findings-input <file>           Read diagnostic findings JSON so proposals
                                    can cite triggeringFindingId evidence
  --receipt-output <file>           Apply mode only: export this run's mutation
                                    receipts as one JSON artifact (the
                                    per-receipt files under receipts.dir are
                                    written either way)
  --supersede-receipt <receipt_id>  Apply mode only: proceed past an in-doubt
                                    receipt you have inspected; the new receipt
                                    records which one it supersedes
  -h, --help                        display help for command
```
